dropped.item: "That's not the experience we want you to have": an expression of the company's standards and empathy
"we'll be glad to help": the warm offer of assistance in the call to action
"Thank you for your patience" and the closing second apology for the inconvenience
"only" in "after only five months", which softened the emphasis that the failure was premature

changed.item: Actor of the tracking email changed from "We'll email you" (the company) to "I'll email you" (the individual agent personally)
"Your bike is covered by our 2-year warranty" became "The Metro 2 is covered by our 2-year warranty". The scope shifted from this customer's specific bike to the model line in general.
"I apologize for the wait in getting back to you" became "sorry it took us so long to get back to you". This is a stronger admission of delay.

added.item: Explicit eligibility reasoning: "a battery that stopped charging after five months qualifies". The original implied this but did not state it as a warranty-qualification rule.
